extension.name: Steam Unslop
extension.description: Blurs Steam games with an AI disclosure and shows how strongly and for what AI was used.
extension.settingsHint: Games rated below this level stay visible. You can also change this with the gear button in any Steam Unslop dialog.

millennium.title: Steam Unslop
millennium.description: Games with an AI disclosure are blurred in the store. Click a tile to see the reason; the gear button in that dialog sets from which level games are blurred.
millennium.minLevelHint: Exceptions and the level quiz are in the store: Unslop button next to the search.

ui.noteHead: Rating uncertain. The developer qualifies their use of AI:
ui.lowered: The level was therefore lowered from {from} to {to}.
ui.noteTail: Detection is keyword-based. If in doubt, read the developer's statement.
ui.intro: The developer has disclosed AI-generated content for this game.
ui.starText: Like Steam Unslop? Leave a star on GitHub!
ui.settingsIntro: Choose which games are blurred. Games rated below the level stay visible.
minLevelHints: Every game with an AI disclosure, even if it gives no details.
Skips disclosures that name no recognizable use.
Games where AI made noticeable content, such as art, voices or several smaller parts.
Only live AI during play or AI in several core areas.
ui.tutorialIntro: Games whose developers disclose AI-generated content are blurred everywhere in the store: tiles, search results, the wishlist, screenshots and trailers.
ui.tutorialTile: The rating says how much AI was used, the tags say what for. Each blurred game offers three actions:
ui.tutorialWhy: Shows the developer's own statement and why it was rated this way.
ui.tutorialShow: Reveals the game on this page.
ui.tutorialIgnore: Puts the game on your Steam ignore list.
ui.tutorialPages: Before the page of an AI game opens, Steam Unslop asks first. You can change your choice at any time:
ui.tutorialGear: At the top of every Steam Unslop dialog.
ui.tutorialLevel: Games rated below the level you pick stay visible.
ui.quizButton: Not sure? Find your level with examples
ui.quizQuestion: Should a game with this disclosure be blurred?
ui.quizResult: Based on your answers, this level fits best:
ui.quizKeepQuestion: Do you want to keep it?
quizExamples: AI tools were used during development.
The German and French translations were made with AI.
AI helped with programming parts of the game.
AI was used as a starting point for some textures, which our artists then reworked.
Some item icons were generated with AI.
The music was composed with AI.
Character portraits and voice lines were generated with AI.
NPCs answer you through a large language model while you play.
ui.ignoreTagsLabel: Never blur when AI was only used for
ui.allowIntro: These games are never blurred. Add one with "Always show" in its dialog.
